definitions.gloss: constantly; always; at all times; permanently
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is continuously active, available, or in effect without interruption. Often used in technical, business, and institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {常時|じょうじ}⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常時|じょうじ}⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This building has security guards at all times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常時|じょうじ}100⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えて→取り揃える：22624_torisoroeru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: We always have 100 varieties of products available in the store.

notes:
A formal adverb meaning 'at all times' or 'permanently.' Composed of {常|じょう} (constant) and ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time). Used to describe systems, services, or states that are continuously maintained without interruption.

USAGE:
More formal and technical than ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ or ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Frequently used in business, IT, and institutional contexts: {常時|じょうじ}⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧ (always-on connection), {常時|じょうじ}⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧ (constant monitoring), {常時|じょうじ}⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧ (permanent employment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常時|じょうじ}⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧ — always-on connection
- {常時|じょうじ}⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧ — constant monitoring
- {常時|じょうじ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ — available at all times
- {常時|じょうじ}⟦{開放|かいほう}→開放：00445_kaihou⟧ — permanently open

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ — always; the everyday casual word
- ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — constantly, always; literary and emphatic
- ⟦{随時|ずいじ}→随時：16144_zuiji⟧ — at any time, as needed; implies availability on demand rather than continuous operation
